client_configurations.label: Claude Code

setup.label: Configuration
setup.value: ~/.claude/settings.json for user configuration; .claude/settings.json for project configuration.

setup.label: API key
setup.value: Replace <gateway api token> with a gateway API key before using this Claude Code configuration.

notes: Generated client configs cap the input context window at 200000 tokens to keep long-context costs predictable; edit the limit in the client config if you want to use a larger window.

ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL is set to the Claude-compatible gateway base URL; Claude Code appends Anthropic endpoints such as /v1/messages and /v1/models. OpenCode and Pi also use Anthropic Messages for this model via http://127.0.0.1:3000.
